summary: Side-effect counter validation: `imports blame` and `imports watch --verify` must parse every inspected import side-effect counter as a non-negative integer and return their existing partial API failure when any present counter is malformed or negative.
reason: Preferred `retryableFailed` and `exhaustedFailed` keys retain their legacy-key fallback and conflict checks, but use the same counter parser as all other side-effect keys. Endpoint-level regression coverage lives beside both import commands.
